Hi Chris,

I saw your opening for an E-Comm Static Ads Designer at jobgether and wanted to connect because of your focus on high-volume, performance-driven static creatives for e-commerce.

At Ascent Business Solutions, I design 100+ digital and print creatives while building reusable templates and visual systems that cut turnaround times. For a recent fashion brand social campaign, my work delivered a 15 percent increase in follower engagement through structured visual hierarchy and rapid iteration.

You can see this work in my fashion brand social campaign study in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/, which demonstrates how I drive measurable interaction through layout and design choices.

Would you be open to a quick look at that case study, or a 15-minute chat this week?

Ananya

Ananya Saini
+91-8605846929
